name_zh: 尼泊尔·普拉昌达：毛派和平与共和国联邦过渡
name_en: Nepal Prachanda: Maoist Peace & Republic Federal Transition
description_zh: 普拉昌达 (1954-) 尼泊尔毛派领袖/总理 (2008-2009, 2016-2017, 2022-2023)，十年人民战争后签署和平协议，废除君主制建立联邦共和国，推动过渡正义与包容性宪法。
description_en: Prachanda (1954-) Nepal Maoist leader/PM (2008-2009, 2016-2017, 2022-2023), signed peace agreement after decade Peoples War, abolished monarchy established federal republic, promoted transitional justice and inclusive constitution.
reason_zh: 普拉昌达代表毛派武装革命如何通过和平协议转型为民主政党，展示了后冲突社会如何通过过渡正义处理战争遗恩，其三度总理经历折射尼泊尔民主巩固的曲折。
reason_en: Prachanda represents how Maoist armed revolution transforms into democratic party through peace agreement, demonstrating how post-conflict society processes war legacy through transitional justice, his three premierships reflecting Nepal democratic consolidation tortuous path.
steps_zh: 研究普拉昌达早年教师与地下党组织经历
分析1996-2006人民战争与2006和平协议签署
探讨2008制宪会议废除君主制建立共和国
评估过渡正义委员会真相调查与受害者赔偿
总结毛派和平共和国联邦过渡对南亚后冲突转型的示范
steps_en: Study Prachanda early teacher and underground party experience
Analyze 1996-2006 Peoples War and 2006 peace agreement signing
Explore 2008 Constituent Assembly abolishing monarchy establishing republic
Evaluate Transitional Justice Commission truth investigation and victim compensation
Summarize Maoist peace republic federal transition demonstration for South Asian post-conflict transition
expected_zh: 掌握武装革命向民主政党转型的和平路径，理解过渡正义在后冲突社会愈合中的核心机制，评估普拉昌达模式对斯里兰卡缅甸等后冲突国家的启示。
expected_en: Master armed revolution to democratic party peaceful transition path, understand transitional justice core mechanism in post-conflict society healing, evaluate Prachanda model lessons for Sri Lanka Myanmar post-conflict nations.
case_zh: 1996 人民战争；2006 和平协议；2008 共和国；三度总理。毛派和平共和国联邦过渡范式永存。
case_en: 1996 Peoples War; 2006 peace agreement; 2008 republic; three-time PM. Maoist peace republic federal transition paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Maoist transition; peace agreement; federalism; transitional justice
